node.title: Exact-list first-match summed numerator budget
node.statement: For every official x4 row and every quotient row consumed by TR, print one support-wise priority map and exact integer list-side numerators U_paid, U_QD, U_MT, and U_prim for the paid background, quotient/dihedral, structured moment/U2, and primitive star buckets. Prove coverage, coalescing, and the single comparison U_paid+U_QD+U_MT+U_prim <= B*=floor(|F|/2^128), using U_MT<=n^3 only from u2c and U_prim<=16n^3 only from the direct local primitive-star target. QA.22 may supply arithmetic evidence but its per-pair MCA slope reserve is not this list-side certificate. The table must include every row actually consumed; six-candidate arithmetic cannot silently certify the wider 29-row or quotient-row family.
node.falsifier: A consumed official or quotient row where the complete disjoint list-side column sum exceeds B*, an assigned support is omitted or counted twice, or the asserted sum uses an MCA slope numerator in place of a list-member numerator.
